title: Tech Starter Timeline
summary: A factory-ready 1.0.0 template with reinforced power, high-voltage routing, logistics, multiblocks, Lens, HoloMap, Terminal, and runtime guidance.
body: Use this card to connect the first 10 minutes, first 30 minutes, and first 2 hours for Tech generated packs.
steps: Open Terminal and read Power Basics.
Build a starter generator or reinforced solar path.
Place a Field Battery Bank and inspect stored power.
Route High Voltage Cable through a Factory Substation.
Run the first Industrial Nexus processor recipe.
